scope: Frozen selected-default round-3 performance and finite byte-exact numerical regression evidence for this model and recorded histories.
interpretation: Individual observations, medians, and percentage changes are descriptive; no statistical significance is claimed.
gen_first_ms measures the first post-prefill evaluation, not user-visible time to first token.
Serialized frontier-logit JSON parity is reported separately from direct full-vocabulary FP32 decode parity.
Numerical equivalence applies to the tested fixtures and histories; it is not a general model-quality evaluation.

provenance.model_hash_limit: Model and PLE are identified by path, size and mtime; full model hashes were not recorded.
provenance.shared_source_limit: Checked current shared sources against the original archive and MTP capture; benchmark runner did not independently hash shared sources at every invocation.
provenance.environment_policy: Runners remove inherited DS4_* variables, then pin Qwen/MoE source paths and apply recorded explicit overrides.

repeated8k.median_change_method: Ratio of the candidate and baseline medians; not the median of paired percentage changes.
repeated8k.context_mode: Fresh single 8192-token prefill per process; 256 generated tokens.

sweep262k.context_mode: Incremental doubling sweep; each process visits all seven frontiers.

reverse262k.context_mode: Incremental doubling sweep; each process visits all seven frontiers.

controlled_decode.format: D4L1: little-endian uint32 context/step/target/vocab, then full FP32 vocabulary

original_diagnostic_provenance.history: 128 actual following prompt tokens per frontier; prefixes extend without replay
original_diagnostic_provenance.allocation_note: Original command omitted --ctx-alloc; default ctx_max + gen_tokens + 1 equals 262273.

controlled_decode.verification: Re-read all ordered headers and full vectors; byte equality and integer exponent-bit finite checks on both sides. Exact finite vectors imply max absolute difference 0.
